**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **Where:** § 11 (¶¶ p0047–p0049) "TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND DATA RETURN", read with § 10.1 (post-termination effects), § 15 (Customer Data) and § 16.5 (which defers Customer Data to §§ 11 and 15).
- **Why:** The clause satisfies the preferred checklist: obligations trigger on expiry or termination for any reason; six months of transition assistance including migration and replacement-supplier cooperation; return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a commonly used, documented, machine-readable format with metadata; and secure deletion after return certified in writing by an authorized officer.
- **Noted, not flagged (both favour us):** assistance is priced at the rates in the expiring Order Form rather than Vendor's then-current rates (no post-termination uplift), and the 30-day return clock runs from our request rather than automatically from termination — with no data-loss exposure because deletion is conditioned on our confirmation of successful return. § 11.2 also blocks any attempt to hold data against a fee dispute, so no walk-away trigger exists.
